what: AR14: the base's own kit, a power yard. Made and laid as Lantern Row's kit is.
frame: Roblox's: a piece's front (Blender +Y) is -Z. A MeshPart goes at the piece's place times `centre`. A light's `at` is in the piece's own frame.
surface: one SurfaceAppearance per MeshPart: ColorMap `colour`, EmissiveMaskContent `glow`, EmissiveTint `glowTint`, EmissiveStrength from `glowStrength` (tuned in the engine). Single sided: each piece's ink is in its mesh, a hull turned inside out on the atlas's ink texel.
ink: the drawn edge is a hull 0.11 studs out (base_ink.py); Lantern Row's is 0.14
shadows: CastShadow off on PowerSpan and the floors (Court1, Yard, Wings, YardLive, YardBack, WingsLive, WingsBack).

maps.Base_Deck_Color.png: the plain deck, a tile 8 studs square (four plates), for a Texture on a Part

Court1.note: lies 0.06 over the deck, its front edge on the plot's; a Part under it carries the walking

Yard.note: lies 0.06 over the deck behind the court, block after block; a Part under it carries the walking

Wings.note: lies 0.06 over the deck each side of the court and of the yard's blocks, the two sides one mesh; a Part under it carries the walking

YardLive.note: lies 0.06 over the deck behind the court, block after block; a Part under it carries the walking

YardBack.note: lies 0.06 over the deck behind the court, block after block; a Part under it carries the walking

WingsBack.note: lies 0.06 over the deck each side of the court and of the yard's blocks, the two sides one mesh; a Part under it carries the walking

Wall.collision: the post, and the panel as a wall 5 studs high
Wall.note: the panel runs 16 studs along +X to the next post

WallHalf.collision: the post, and the panel as a wall 5 studs high
WallHalf.note: the panel runs 8 studs along +X to the next post

WallEnd.note: a run's last post: no panel

Gate1.collision: a box round each tower's foot, 4.6 square, and the two shoulders as walls
Gate1.note: clear between the towers' feet: 39.4 studs, 14 under the floods; the plate's faces are +Y and -Y, 11 by 4.4 at 16 up: the base's level is the builder's text on both

Pylon.note: its arms lie along Y: stand it with its X along the line it carries

PowerSpan.note: from a pylon's place to the next, 48 studs along +X, both pylons turned the same way

FloodMast.note: its head reaches 3 studs toward +Y; a SpotLight straight down from Pool where the plan has one

Door.collision: the step, 14 by 4 and 0.6 high, and the front ring, 12.8 across and 1.6 deep, round its opening; the opening stays open
Door.note: its origin is the step's middle on the floor; its mouth looks toward -Y, so at the plan's turn of 90 it looks down the way in. The way a player walks into is the ring's opening: 10 across, from 0.6 to 10.6 up, in the ring's front at -1 along its Y. The name goes on the plate's -Y face, 5 by 1.3, its middle 12.3 up. The line of light round the opening is the Door's own: full always

DoorRing1.note: ring 1 of 4 behind the Door's front ring, 1.7 behind it, 5.3 in radius. Its origin is its middle, on the tunnel's axis: it turns about its own Y, the axis, at 9 degrees a second, anticlockwise seen from the mouth, always, whatever the Door's state. Look only

DoorRing2.note: ring 2 of 4 behind the Door's front ring, 3 behind it, 4.4 in radius. Its origin is its middle, on the tunnel's axis: it turns about its own Y, the axis, at 14 degrees a second, clockwise seen from the mouth, always, whatever the Door's state. Look only

DoorRing3.note: ring 3 of 4 behind the Door's front ring, 4.1 behind it, 3.6 in radius. Its origin is its middle, on the tunnel's axis: it turns about its own Y, the axis, at 20 degrees a second, anticlockwise seen from the mouth, always, whatever the Door's state. Look only

DoorRing4.note: ring 4 of 4 behind the Door's front ring, 5 behind it, 2.9 in radius. Its origin is its middle, on the tunnel's axis: it turns about its own Y, the axis, at 28 degrees a second, clockwise seen from the mouth, always, whatever the Door's state. Look only

DoorWay.note: the Door's core, 4.8 across, 5.9 behind its mouth, facing it. Its origin is its middle. Its glow's strength is the Door's state: full while a ground is open to go to, low while none is. Keep its tint white, or its warmth goes. Look only: the way a player walks into is the Door's opening (the Door's note), not this

Training.collision: the deck, 6 by 4.6 and 0.5 high, the stone on it, about 2.8 square and 6.9 high, and the pad, 4 square and 0.4 high, 6 toward the piece's front
Training.note: its middle on the stand-in's; the pad is in the piece, 6 toward its front, where the stand-in's pad is. The one who trains stands at the pad's middle, facing the stone. Its crown is TrainingCrown, floating 8 up

TrainingCrown.note: its origin is its middle: it floats 8 up at the Training machine's middle, round the stone's spark, and turns about its own upright while a Voidkin trains, still when none does. 7.6 across at its weights. Look only

Breaker.collision: a box, 14 by 6, 5 high, and the jaws' two feet
Breaker.note: on the stand-in's footprint, 12.8 high. A chamber stands at across 3.5 each side, its foot on the body's top at 5. The crystal is the Breaker's lamp, its middle 10.2 up, where the builder's BreakerLamp is

BreakerChamber.note: its place is the chamber's middle across, on the body's top (5 up): the stand-in's cube from 5 to 9. The shard's room is between the points, 5.85 to 8.35 up, its middle at 7.1. Look only

BreakerWaiting.note: on the stand-in's pad, 2.5 square and 1 high; a waiting shard stands on its tray, 0.9 up

Bay.collision: a box, 10 square, 0.4 high, and the crescent's two feet
Bay.note: on the stand-in's pad, 9.4 high at its horns' tips. Its crescent stands on -X: turn 0 on the plot's left, 180 on its right, so the eye is on the outer side and the worker is seen under it from the court and the gate. The worker stands at the pad's middle; the eye's middle is 8 up

BayHalo.note: stands where its Bay stands, the same turn, only while a worker works there. One pale swatch on every face: the worker's rarity colour is the builder's (a tint, or the mesh in Neon without the kit's pictures). Its light is a PointLight in the same colour, the first to go if the plot's lights weigh. Look only

BaySleeping.collision: a box, 10 square, 0.4 high; the rest is under a stud high
BaySleeping.note: stands where a Bay will stand, the same turn, until the base's level wakes that bay; then the Bay takes its place. It lies low, about 1.5 high. Nothing on it glows

SleepingStone.collision: a box, 9 square, 0.4 high; the rest is under a stud high
SleepingStone.note: stands where a machine the base hasn't woken will stand (plan.json, layout, sleeping), until that machine has its model and its phase. It lies low, about 1.5 high. Nothing on it glows

TowerSleeping.collision: a box, 28 square, as high as it needs; nobody reaches it yet
TowerSleeping.note: stands behind the back wall on the plot's middle line, on the Tower's own lot: 172 high at its tip, 28 square at its foot. A violet slate, unlit but for the shard over its tip. No hull

BatteryRack.note: on the stand-in's footprint, 2.85 high at its posts. Its eight seats are 0.6 up; a BatteryCell stands on each seat the base's level has earned (plan.json, machines, battery)

BatteryCell.note: its origin is its seat on the rack, 0.6 up; 2.16 high above it. Its glow is its own charge: the builder lights the cells in the seats' order as the battery fills. Look only

Generator.collision: in the piece's frame (across, toward the gate, up): the well shut to walking, a cylinder of radius 10.6, 3 high, at the middle; the sill a box 22.4 across, 1.8 deep and 1.4 high, its middle 4.6 toward the gate; each raked leg's foot a box 2.8 square, 1 high, at across +-7.6, 14 back; each raked leg a Part 1.3 thick along its line, from (+-7.6, -14, 0.3) to (+-1.5, -3.6, 8.7). The trestle stands on the sill and the arm over the well: look only
Generator.note: its middle on the well's. The wheel (GeneratorWheel) turns on its axle 10 up, 23.2 across; the gauge's steps (GeneratorArc1 to 8) stand still behind its band, and the demand's mark (GeneratorDemand) rides the rail outside its rim. The collector's arm reaches about 22.5 up. The well light stays: VoidWell, 1.6 up in its middle

GeneratorWheel.note: its origin is its axle's middle, 10 up at the generator's middle; its axle lies along the piece's Y (Roblox's Z), the line to the gate. From the gate it turns anticlockwise, so the buckets rise on the gate's right and run under the collector's claw: in Roblox, CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -angle) with the angle growing, faster as the plant generates more. Its lower edge runs 1.6 under the floor, inside the well's dark
